response.first_sentence: `WebhookClient.send` in `src/webhook_client.py` now makes up to 3 attempts on 5xx with exponential backoff, and returns `False` on the first 4xx.

comments: # Partners register one HTTPS endpoint each. Delivery is at-least-once; the
# Timeouts and connection errors are not retried; they raise on the first
# Jitter: a partner outage fails many events at once, and
# unjittered retries would all land on it together.
# 429 fails fast with the rest of 4xx; Retry-After is not honored.
